narrative: Five-day phonics arc moving from phonemic awareness on Day 1, to letter-sound mapping on Day 2, to blending on Day 3, to decoding in connected text on Day 4, to a capstone integration on Day 5. Sequence aligns with the Science of Reading consensus path: phonological awareness precedes alphabetic principle precedes blending precedes connected reading. Each day's activities are designed to be reusable in Day 5's stations.

key_skill_per_day.1: Phoneme isolation and segmentation (auditory only, no print)
key_skill_per_day.2: Letter-to-sound mapping for short-vowel CVC patterns
key_skill_per_day.3: Blending three sounds into a CVC word
key_skill_per_day.4: Decoding CVC words within short connected sentences

scaffolding_strategy: PA-first per Ehri's phases. Day 1 stays purely auditory so children separate sound-work from letter-work. Day 2 introduces print only after phonological awareness is stable. Day 3 reverses Day 1's operation (segment becomes blend) using the Day 2 letter-sound knowledge. Day 4 transfers blending to connected text. Day 5 rotates back through every prior skill at independent practice level.
capstone_integration_plan: Day 5 has 4 stations of approximately 5 minutes each: (1) PA segmenting using picture cards revisits Day 1 (auditory only). (2) Letter-sound match using letter index cards revisits Day 2 (print at letter level). (3) Word building using sound boxes and letter cards revisits Day 3 (blending). (4) Sentence reading using a decodable strip revisits Day 4 (connected text). Each child rotates through all 4 stations. The capstone template records evidence per station for the summative rubric.
